ngaap.guidance: 2023 guidance updated to incorporate Aerojet Rocketdyne for the five post-acquisition months; legacy LHX unchanged (26-Oct-2023; assumes no U.S. Government shutdown): Revenue $19.2B - $19.4B, up ~13% - 14% (prior / legacy $18.0B - $18.3B, up ~5.5% - 7.0%; AR $1.0B+); segment operating income $2.8B - $2.9B (prior / legacy $2.7B - $2.8B; AR ~$120M); segment operating margin ~14.8% (legacy ~15%); non-GAAP EPS $12.25 - $12.45 (prior $12.15 - $12.55; midpoint unchanged; AR contribution offset by acquisition interest); adjusted free cash flow $2.0B+ (unchanged). By segment (no change): SAS revenue $6.7B - $6.8B (bias higher), operating income $735M - $760M (bias higher); IMS $6.7B - $6.8B (bias lower), $765M - $800M (bias lower); CS $4.9B - $5.0B (bias higher), $1.20B - $1.23B; AR $1.0B+, ~$120M. Other: FAS/CAS pension adjustment, net ~$410M (prior ~$395M; service cost ~(30) vs ~(25), CAS pension cost ~(130) vs ~(120), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~100 vs ~95, non-service FAS pension income ~310 vs ~300); net interest expense ~$545M (prior ~$420M; ~$125M for AR financing); non-GAAP effective tax rate 13.0% - 13.5%; average diluted shares ~191M; capex ~$330M (prior ~$275M). LHX NeXt: gross run-rate savings ~$500M exiting year 3 for ~$400M of cash costs over three years. Debt reduction goal ~$3.0B; leverage target below 3.0x (3.7x at quarter end).
ngaap.notes: 2023 basis: 'Segment operating income' in the tables is GAAP segment operating income; 'Non-GAAP segment operating income' excludes segment-level impairment charges. Non-GAAP EPS = EPS (no discontinued operations in 2023) plus the after-tax adjustments listed: amortization of acquisition-related intangibles; additional cost of sales related to the fair value step-up in inventory sold (TDL, new 1Q23); L3Harris merger-related integration expenses (2022 only); acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses (TDL, AJRD); pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related expenses; business divestiture-related gains; impairment of other assets; and the enterprise transformation program, renamed LHX NeXt in 2Q23 (new 1Q23). Pension (FAS/CAS operating adjustment, non-service FAS pension income) is NOT excluded. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow less capex (net of proceeds) plus cash used for merger / acquisition-related transaction and integration costs. The FCF bridge in the release is the quarter column; cf in this file is year to date. 3Q23 label changes: integration and transaction lines combined into 'Merger, acquisition, and divestiture-related expenses' (TDL and AR in 2023; L3Harris merger in 2022; includes the former pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related expenses), and 'Sale of asset group and business divestiture-related gains, net'. Adjustments: amortization 208, merger/acquisition/divestiture-related 56, LHX NeXt 33; income taxes (72); total after tax 225; non-GAAP net income 607. Adjusted FCF now also adds back cash used for LHX NeXt (25 in the quarter, 45 YTD; new this quarter) and cash used for merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses (215; 267 YTD); YTD adjusted FCF 1,307. YTD non-GAAP EPS $9.01. Net debt / adjusted EBITDA 3.7x. No adjusted EBIT published (GAAP EBIT 559, 11.4%).
